observations: The draft establishes a clearly compact single chair with warm mustard upholstery, two thick arms, one seat, short feet and three pale stuffing lobes. It is a coherent native four-facing object.

The S back/front-facing cushion and its top read as a symmetrical rounded rectangular block. The target's distinctive broad asymmetric sag/puffy depression is not visibly established in these captures.

The broken arm is legible and attached at the base, with brown inner wooden members. Its upper/lower bright fabric borders read as thin straight rails framing a tall rectangular void, especially S and E, rather than a soft irregular torn fabric opening.
Seat stuffing is visible in S/E. Fine dark scratches and mottling are restrained but the exact tear/stuffing integration needs native-size confirmation.
Source camera differs from target; this feedback does not request camera or frame changes.

blockers.location: S-facing back cushion and its top/side silhouette
blockers.materialEffect: The model loses the chosen target's most characteristic worn cushion volume and reads like a new rectangular padded chair.
blockers.desiredOutcome: Create a visibly puffy, broadly asymmetrically sagged/indented back that is legible under the fixed high source camera. Avoid a superficial tiny dent; the cushion should feel soft and worn.

blockers.location: Broken left arm in S and E; exposed upper edge in N/W
blockers.materialEffect: Thin straight bright rims and the vertical void read as an exposed rigid slot/box rather than torn upholstered arm construction.
blockers.desiredOutcome: Keep the clear inner structure, but make the attached mustard fabric edge visibly thicker, irregular and folded/torn. Resolve any thin unsupported upper edge and avoid a uniform outline rail.

remainingDifferences: Mustard palette, broad rounded padding and coherent rear/side upholstery are already directionally appropriate. Exact target stains or geometry counts are unnecessary.

technicalEvidence.limits: Provisional half-frame draft only. No packet, full-size captures, consumer preview or native validation was submitted; no technical pass or final approval is given.
